'''Junki Takegami''' ({{j|武上純希}} ''Takegami Junki'') born February 26, 1955 in {{wp|Kagoshima Prefecture|Kagoshima}}, {{wp|Japan}}) is a writer of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He has written a number of episodes for {{aniseries|PTS}}, the first being ''[[EP005|Showdown in Pewter City]]''.
